core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gamal corresponds to the Arabic form جمال (Arabic root ج م ل (j-m-l); جَمال (Jamāl)). Its core sense is beautiful, lovely. Gamal is an Egyptian spelling of Arabic جمال (Jamāl) 'beauty, handsomeness', from the root ج م ل (j-m-l). The source gloss 'camel driver' is a confusion with جَمّال (jammāl) 'camel driver' and has been removed; the correct sense is 'beauty'. It is well known from Gamal Abdel Nasser.
